name: waf-packaging
description: Package any web app behind a ModSecurity + OWASP CRS WAF container, manageable and reversible. Technology-agnostic (works with any backend served over HTTP) but tuned for FastAPI backends. Guides adding a reverse-proxy WAF in front of an existing app via docker-compose, starting in DetectionOnly, applying app-specific CRS exclusions, and moving to blocking mode safely.
